alt: Item의 매핑을 각 BACKGROUND·PROP 테이블에 상속하고 별도 ITEM 테이블은 없는 구조
prompt: Create ONE original raster PNG technical educational diagram for a Korean IT blog. White opaque background, navy readable sans-serif text, flat blue/teal boxes, generous whitespace. Use only the exact subject and components below. No logos, watermark, decorative illustrations, unrelated graphs, extra numeric values or invented facts. Redesign composition rather than copy source. Every connection must be accurate and labels fully readable.  Title @MappedSuperclass. Above dashed CLASS ONLY card Item: id, price, url. Caption Mapping metadata; no ITEM table. Two dashed inheritance arrows toward lower schema cards BACKGROUND columns PRICE, ID (PK), BACKGROUND_NAME, URL and PROP columns PRICE, ID (PK), PROP_NAME, URL. Common ID/PRICE/URL blue highlight in both, subtype-specific names teal. No ITEM_TYPE, no parent FK. Use exact @MappedSuperclass spelling. Footer Inherited mappings are stored in each entity table.
